title: Iteration Loop
summary: Improvement = one edit at a time — Surgical Edit prevents Regression

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** **Improvement = one edit at a time** — **not 'change everything' or 'wipe and start over'**.
- **Why now?** **After planning the interface, the first version of the AI won't be perfect** — **this lesson teaches you how to fix it safely**.
- **What after the lesson?** **You will write a request for one surgical edit** — **specific and guaranteed results**.

sections.heading: Tension — The interface looks bad — wipe everything?
sections.subtitle: The interface looks bad — wipe everything?
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **AI built the interface** — **the colors don't match and the button is misplaced**. **First reaction: 'Wipe everything'**.
- **But that's the slowest way**. **Every professional interface takes 4–7 improvement loops** — **not just one version**.
- **The secret: request one specific edit at a time** — **and see the result before the next**.

sections.heading: Core idea — One edit at a time — Improvement Loop
sections.subtitle: One edit at a time — Improvement Loop
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Iteration Loop = 4 steps**: **Request → See the result → Review → Edit**. **Each loop brings you closer to the desired shape**.
- **Surgical Edit**: «**Make the submit button orange #FF6B35 — don't change anything else.**»
- **If you request many edits at once**, **the AI will guess** — **and it might ruin something that was working (Regression)**.

sections.heading: Comparison — 'Change it' vs Surgical Edit
sections.subtitle: 'Change it' vs Surgical Edit
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Error — 'The interface looks bad' | Correct — One specific edit |
|---------------------------|----------------------|
| **AI doesn't understand 'bad'**. **It guesses and changes randomly** — **it might ruin what was working** | «**On the chat page, make the 'Send' button color dark blue #000080 and the text white. Don't change anything else.**» **Specific edit = guaranteed result** |

sections.heading: Glossary — Two terms for improvement
sections.subtitle: Two terms for improvement
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| **Iteration** | **Experiment → Observe → Fix → Experiment again — until you reach the goal** | **Like a tailor: Measurements → Adjust → New Measurements** |
| **Regression** | **When you fix something and it breaks something else that was working** | **I adjusted the font size in the chat — and suddenly the header got messed up** |

sections.heading: Mission — Write a safe surgical edit request
sections.subtitle: Write a safe surgical edit request
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** **10 minutes is enough**.

**Delivery:**

1. **The page or element** (like 'the submit button on the chat page')
2. **What exactly do you want to change** (color, size, position — **only one thing**)
3. **The complete surgical prompt**
4. **What did you say 'don't change'?**

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| Surgical Edit | 70% | **Prompt requests only one edit**. **Element and page specified — not 'the whole interface'** |
| Protection from Regression | 30% | **Clearly states 'don't change anything else' or equivalent** |

sections.heading: Confidence close
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **You understood:** **Improvement = one edit at a time**. **'Change everything' is slower and riskier than a surgical edit**.
- **You can:** **prompt a safe edit — ready for any interface**.
- **Next:** **Debugging** — **when things go wrong, how to describe the problem and isolate the cause**.
